title: The Missing Product
story: The shop's inventory system processed today's products, but the owner noticed that the last product was never recorded. The system runs without crashing, so the developer didn't notice the problem immediately.
bug: The loop stops one position too early, so the last product is never processed.
expected_output:
Processing: Rice
Processing: Milk
Processing: Sugar
Processing: Tea
Processing: Oil
actual_output:
Processing: Rice
Processing: Milk
Processing: Sugar
Processing: Tea
clues: The system successfully processes most of the products. Check how it decides when to stop.
Look closely at the number of times the loop is allowed to run.
len(products) tells you how many products exist. Why might subtracting 1 cause a problem?
